vault.//: Assembles the site's vault, dist/vault, from its sources: content/public, then the private notes' stubs in dist/vault-private, each at the vault's root (src/lib/assembly.ts). Notes are copied, with each link's public/ or private/ prefix (Obsidian's, from content/) taken off and each tags/<tag>/index link written tags/<tag> (src/lib/link-prefixes.ts), and attachments linked; what git ignores, and dotfiles, are left out; a source that isn't there is empty; a path in both sources fails it, naming both files. dist/vault/.sources.json names each file's source, for its git dates. Never cached: it takes a fraction of a second, and the cache would keep its links as copies.

dev.//: Astro's dev server over the assembled vault, dist/vault. The vault's sources are watched, and the vault assembled and read again whenever a file in one changes, so a new or renamed note's links follow without a restart.

build.//: Build the assembled vault into astro/dist, once `check` passes and `vault` has assembled it: astro build strips types without checking them. The vault and its sources are inputs, so a changed note rebuilds. So is the resume, which `resume:build` compiles into dist/resume and the site publishes (src/lib/resume.ts).

test.//: The unit tests of the pure modules under src/lib, on Vitest, over the fixture vault (test/fixtures/vault). One file: `nx run astro:test -- test/notes.test.ts`.

mirrors.//: Saves a mirror of each annotated document that has none into the mirror directory, the repository's dist/mirrors (MIRRORS_ROOT overrides it), never into the vault; the site serves each under assets/annotated-documents (docs/adr/2801). A saved mirror is pinned and never fetched again; delete it to fetch it afresh. The only target that reaches the network for the vault: run it before a build that should have every mirror, as the deploy does. A document that can't be fetched is reported, and its page is built with its annotations alone.

e2e.//: The Playwright specs against the built site: over the fixture vault (src/test/fixture), or with the `vault` configuration over the real one (src/test/vault). The suite builds its own site into .e2e and serves it on a port of its own, which E2E_PORT overrides (docs/adr/0007). One spec: `nx run astro:e2e -- notes`. Never beside another build in the same checkout, and never beside its dev server, which the suite refuses to start next to: every build writes the same .astro directory, and the dev server reads it. Stop the dev server first, or run the suite from another worktree.
